evidence_update_note: Searched through 29 Oct 2026. Primary full-paper VISION 2023 and EMA previously treated results retained. 2025 treatment-sequencing and 2026 long-responder subset conference abstracts are labelled separately; no outcome-selected subgroup prognosis is assigned to an unselected patient.
source_conflicts: NCCP expects no renal dose adjustment below CrCl 30 mL/min or on haemodialysis; current SmPC says severe renal use is not recommended because unstudied. Consultant/pharmacy reconciliation required.
NCCP and SmPC do not specify a CTCAE edition for the dose-modification table; no automatic v5 label.
VISION includes first-line patients, but NCCP 00823a and EU indication are after immunotherapy and/or platinum chemotherapy.
Bilirubin and absence of cholestasis/haemolysis are essential to the combined liver permanent-stop pathway.
